nodes.label: Approval Policy Engine
nodes.rationale: Classifies MCP tools READ/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/SYNC/ADMIN; an approval binds an immutable argument snapshot and is invalidated if arguments, target, or permissions change.

nodes.label: MCP Gateway
nodes.rationale: The only module allowed to talk to external MCP servers; revalidates rights against the source right before a mutation and uses idempotency keys for creates/syncs; the LLM never holds tokens or chooses the execution identity.

nodes.label: Knowledge Service
nodes.rationale: A RAG response is assembled only after filtering by user, tenant, project, space, and resource; source identifiers used are recorded with the generated message.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Turns a proposed mutation tool call into a persisted ActionProposal instead of executing it; bounds step/call counts to avoid runaway loops and cost; LLMProvider interface decouples the domain from the Groq SDK.

hyperedges.label: Human-approval mutation chain (propose -> approve -> revalidate -> execute -> audit)
